_doc: Seed for the notion-pages-databases-only mock. Loaded into opts.store.notion
by the plugin (opts.seed, or store.seed). Every record is keyed by its id;
the plugin forces record.id to the key, so the two can never drift.
Ids in the 2a9e0000-... space are pages, 7b3d0000-... are databases - the
same shape the plugin's own counter mints, so seeded and created records
are indistinguishable. counter.* is set past the seeded ids so a create

7b3d0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002._quirk: parent is an EMPTY object and title is empty - exactly what the SDK's own generated test data sends, in violation of DatabaseInput.required ['parent','title','properties']. Proves the mock does not enforce required[].

direct01._quirk: Served for ts/test/entity/database/DatabaseDirect.test.ts, which calls sdk.direct({path:'databases/{id}', method:'GET', params:{id:'direct01'}}) and asserts result.data.id === 'direct01'. direct() bypasses the feature pipeline but uses the same auth and headers.

DATABASE00._quirk: Verbatim from .sdk/test/entity/database/DatabaseTestData.json existing.database. The generated suite uses these as client-side entity defaults; seeding them means a load of DATABASE00 also succeeds over HTTP. Note created_time 's46' is not a timestamp at all - the mock stores and echoes it unchanged.

2a9e0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002._quirk: Full rich_text round-trip fixture. `properties` is typed {type:'object'} in the definition - no rich_text, annotations or plain_text is described anywhere in definition, model or generated types - so the SDK neither validates nor transforms this. It must come back byte-identical.

direct01._quirk: Served for ts/test/entity/page/PageDirect.test.ts: sdk.direct({path:'pages/{id}', method:'GET', params:{id:'direct01'}}) asserts result.data.id === 'direct01'.

PAGE00._quirk: Verbatim from .sdk/test/entity/page/PageTestData.json existing.page - parent is {} with no database_id, violating PageInput.required.

_quirks_exercised.required-not-enforced: database 7b3d...0002, PAGE00-02, DATABASE00-02 all carry parent:{} - the empty parent the SDK's own generated test data sends.
_quirks_exercised.opaque-rich-text: page 2a9e...0002 carries a two-run rich_text title with annotations, a link, select, date and checkbox properties. None of it is described by the definition; it must round-trip unchanged.
_quirks_exercised.created-time-is-not-a-time: PAGE00/DATABASE00 seed created_time 's47'/'s46'. The mock never re-derives created_time, which is what lets BasicPageFlow PATCH created_time:'Mark01-page_ref01_<ts>' and assert the exact string back.
_quirks_exercised.direct-fixture: page/direct01 and database/direct01 exist because direct() tests hit a hard-coded id.

_off_by_default._doc: Both of these stay OFF: the SDK neither rate-limits nor retries (feature.ratelimit and feature.retry are active:false in Config.ts), so a mock enforcing Notion's ~3 req/sec would hard-fail the first caller with no backoff. Copy either key up to the top level of this file, or set it on store.notion directly, to exercise the failure path.
